github_actions.scope: Exact-source preflight, DEV-only tests, 2 fresh DEV seeds, checkpoint/source checks. No final full repo regression or unfamiliar held first-use.

decision_rationale: DEV seed 40811 has 80/170 (47.06%) class-pure A+B archived source coverage across late B/return, below frozen 50% requirement; 0/90 of late B episodes have A+B archived options under the 16-event disjointness constraint. In seed 40812, oracle phase-selected archival forecasts worsen vs native stream by 0.02343 Brier. Even the privileged oracle ceiling does not establish a useful native archive.
scientific_limits: Regime class grouping (A/B) and chosen oracle source are evaluator-only labels. Apparent 100% conditional discrimination is not a deployable unsupervised recognition result and holds only on covered events.
Source models finishing within the previous 16-event evidence window are excluded to prevent in-sample evidence leakage.
Only two DEV seeds from reused binary synthetic families; not independent unfamiliar-world transfer, real-world knowledge or general intelligence.
Source code's field source_model_count counts source episodes per seed, NOT distinct archive models; do not interpret that mislabeled field as trained-model cardinality.
Runtime wall time differs by OS; only deterministically scored metrics and checkpoint/source digests are compared.
Negative DEV gate means full final regression, pilot and primary first-use intentionally STOPPED, not passed.
Separate proxy-fanout workflow failures are infrastructure/orchestration context and are not evidence of this diagnostic's native scientific effect.
next_executable_research: New preregistered experiment should test whether native archive is forming distinct rule-relevant blocks before retrieval; use developmental intervention diversity and source-block formation metrics under matched data/actions and stop early. No CKAD40 seed tuning or promotion.
